commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She goes on, to her friend.

While my lover was here, evening came and my life put out new shoots. Now he is gone, it doesn’t only stop doing that. It comes to take my life, as executioners with no compassion come to the killing ground. It used to be my friend and bring me joy, and today it is my enemy and brings me pain. How am I to bear it?
